title: ANCHOR-RE: An Agentic Biomedical Relation Extraction Framework with Retrieval Augmentation and Error-Driven Verification
abstract: arXiv:2608.03154v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Biomedical relation extraction (BioRE) supports knowledge graph construction and hypothesis generation. In real-world settings, most candidate entity pairs are unrelated. Symbolic systems such as SemRep offer high precision and interpretability but limited recall, whereas large language models (LLMs) can produce false-positive relations. We developed ANCHOR-RE, an agentic framework that combines retrieved demonstrations, ontology-guided semantic constraints, external biomedical knowledge, and error-driven verification to improve BioRE reliability without task-specific fine-tuning. We evaluated ANCHOR-RE on SemRepGS, DDI, and ChemProt using proprietary and open-weight LLMs. To assess generalizability while reducing potential pretraining contamination, we also conducted a post-cutoff temporal precision evaluation using 100 biomedical articles published in 2026. translated_title: ANCHOR-RE：一种结合检索增强与错误驱动验证的智能体化生物医学关系抽取框架
translated_abstract: 生物医学关系抽取（BioRE）支持知识图谱构建与假设生成。在真实场景中，大多数候选实体对之间并无关联。以SemRep为代表的符号系统具有高精确率和可解释性，但召回率有限；而大语言模型（LLM）则可能产生假阳性关系。我们开发了ANCHOR-RE，这是一个智能体化框架，它将检索到的示例、本体引导的语义约束、外部生物医学知识与错误驱动验证相结合，从而在无需任务特定微调的情况下提高生物医学关系抽取的可靠性。我们在SemRepGS、DDI和ChemProt数据集上，使用专有及开放权重大语言模型对ANCHOR-RE进行了评估。为了在减少潜在预训练数据污染的同时评估其泛化能力，我们还使用2026年发表的100篇生物医学文章进行了截止日期之后的时间性精确率评估。使用专有模型作为骨干时，ANCHOR-RE相较直接提示方法提升了微平均F1……（摘要在此处截断）
tldr: ANCHOR-RE是一种融合检索增强示例、本体引导语义约束与错误驱动验证的智能体化框架，无需任务特定微调即可显著提升生物医学关系抽取的可靠性与微平均F1分数。
en_tdlr: ANCHOR-RE is an agentic framework combining retrieved demonstrations, ontology-guided semantic constraints, and error-driven verification to improve biomedical relation extraction reliability and micro-F1 without task-specific fine-tuning.
